text: The 1944986 relocation keeps mail.tabs.drawInTitlebar and mail.tabs.autoHide but moves their registration and controls to Appearance. The toolbar settings shortcut and checkbox task both target paneAppearance/layoutGroup. The checked category selector shows or hides direct paneDeck children by data-category, so moving nested markup alone is not the entire pane contract. The checkbox helper asserts stored preferences and checked states; it does not prove native window layout or search/accessibility behavior. This is scoped source knowledge from the complete relocation patch and selected fixed code; no runtime tests ran.
title: Appearance layout controls keep preference IDs while their pane and shortcut change
